description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the effect of context masking perturbations by tag. The horizontal category axis, labeled "tag," displays four discrete categories ordered from left to right: "case," "gender," "number," and "tense." The vertical value axis, labeled "effect," uses a linear numeric scale ranging from 0 to 20, with tick marks and corresponding horizontal gridlines at intervals of 5. Within each of the four tag categories, the data is represented by a group of six adjacent vertical bars, each corresponding to a specific model configuration as indicated by a legend in the top right corner. The legend defines the bars by color: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light red), and XLM-B₂ (dark red). The highest values are observed in the "case" category, where the mBERT-B₂ bar reaches approximately 12 and the XLM-B₂ bar reaches approximately 11. Conversely, the lowest values are found in the "tense" category, where all six bars measure approximately 1 or below. Across all categories, the B₂ models (light and dark red) consistently display the tallest bars within their respective groups. Every bar in the chart includes a vertical error bar extending above and below the top edge, which indicates the standard deviation. The categories and grouped bars are not sorted by ascending or descending height, and no individual bars are visually emphasized beyond the standard color coding and error bars.
